style.format: Fast full-frame mobile motion: 23 varied shots, immediate shaped display type, no explanatory body text.
style.palette: Pale green, white and black, with sky-blue audio 1, coral audio 2 and yellow accents.
style.typography: Lilita One display, Rubik Black Cyrillic, heavy Japanese and Simplified Chinese; local OFL subsets.
style.sound: 150 BPM original percussive score. Real source waveforms and audible original → added audio, with music ducked during the demonstration.
